result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there is one clear layout defect: overlapping text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, where delivery time and delivery fee labels render on top of each other, making both unreadable.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the text '25–30 min delivery' overlaps with '€0 delivery', rendering both strings illegible in the same line.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout so only one label displays (e.g., '25–30 min delivery • Free' or '€0 delivery'), or ensure the two elements are positioned side by side without overlapping.
